verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and no doc describes an Atlas API spec. The llms.txt and markdown docs pages that do exist are documentation formats, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
